name: Nick Radge Bollinger Blast: 10-bar, 3 sd breakout with 1 sd exit
author: Pine port of Nick Radge Unholy Grail Bollinger idea
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
entry_long: close crosses above SMA(10)+3 x stdev(10) -> long.
exit: close crosses below SMA(10)-1 x stdev(10) -> close long.
stop_loss: Close when open loss exceeds 10% of initial capital
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Long only; stop is on initial capital not position value; "Compra" id mismatch means the stop may not actually close trade ID "Long" - verify.
